I will plant the improved seed they gave me at the depot, not my own saved seed, because my brother used the same seed and his cobs were big. I will not put manure here since this land is not mine, and I have no money for spray or hired workers. My wife and I will do all the work — clearing, planting, weeding three times, and harvesting — which will take us about 50 days on this piece.
